thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT PAGER -> High tail latencies observed for tenant opalfin in dedicated-vpc-usw2-pool. 95th/99th spikes; error_rate slight increase. paging oncall-maria :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): saw the pager, looking... can someone dump recent scheduler metrics for opalfin?

raj (sre): grabbing metrics now. shows steady enqueue growth and long queue wait times on their bespoke queue id=tenant-opalfin-bespoke-7. max_batch_tokens was recently raised to 2048 by last week's tweak.

maria (oncall): ah that explains big batches clogging the pipeline for mixed latencies. tia can you confirm whether their requests are piling on a single worker?

tia (eng-runtime): yeah, worker shard 12 is hot for opalfin. KV cache hits fine, but batching delay is causing serialization spikes. Reproducer tail: 
```
# sample trace
queue_wait_ms: 1200 -> 4500
batch_size_median: 28 -> 210
max_batch_tokens: 2048
```

maria (oncall): ok plan: 1) throttle their max_batch_tokens down to 512 2) enable bespoke queue isolation (move to a dedicated shy-queue) 3) add temporary fast-path alias to a smaller-quantized model if latency not improving.

leo (customer-eng): FYI customer OpalFin is seeing complaints about timeouts on heavy reports. They need some throughput preserved but <1s P95 target. I'll text ops to warn them of mitigation so they don't accidentally restart things.

sarah (support): customer affected count ~ 42 active users, mostly report generation. Ops is getting escalations.

raj (sre): applying knob now: `POST /internal/config/tenant/opalfin` payload `{ "scheduler": { "max_batch_tokens": 512, "max_batch_size": 64 } }`

ops-bot: CONFIG CHANGE APPLIED by raj at 3234567120 -> scheduler.max_batch_tokens=512; scheduler.max_batch_size=64; routing: isolate_to=tenant-opalfin-bespoke-7x

maria (oncall): monitoring... tail latency dropping but still some stragglers. P95 moved 3.2s -> 0.9s over 45s. P99 down from 14s -> 4.5s.

tia (eng-runtime): initiating queue split: spawn 2 extra workers for opalfin shy-queue, pin to different shard to avoid contending KV-cache. Command: `./ctl queues split --tenant opalfin --count 2 --pin-shard=20`

ops-bot: QUEUE ACTION queued by tia at 3234567250 -> split requested, workers provisioning...

leo (customer-eng): relaying to OpalFin: "we're applying targeted throttles and isolating your traffic; expect transient retries but P95 should be much better in ~2m."

raj (sre): workers up, traffic draining to new workers. latency now P95 0.7s, P99 2.1s. error rate normalized.

maria (oncall): good. leaving canary knobs active for 30m then we'll roll a permanent profile. tia, can you capture a perf snapshot and add to the incident ticket? include the `max_batch_tokens` delta and old queue saturation graphs.

tia (eng-runtime): will do, dumping snapshot -> s3://redwood-incidents/3234567000-opalfin-snapshot.tar.gz

maria (oncall): handoff: i'll stay 15 more mins then hand to raj for monitoring. tagging oncall-next: @raj.

raj (sre): ack, will monitor for 2 hours. if tail >3s or enqueue growth > 20% for 5m, escalate to runtime-eng.

leo (customer-eng): customer confirmed improved performance in-app. thank you :tada:

maria (oncall): summary for ticket: OpalFin dedicated VPC tenant experienced bespoke-batching surge due to high `max_batch_tokens` and large report requests. Mitigation: reduced `max_batch_tokens` 2048->512, decreased max_batch_size, split queue, added workers on separate shard, temporary fast-path considered but not required. Follow-ups: persist new scheduler profile, add alert guard when tenant.batch_tokens > 1024, run postmortem if repeats.

ops-bot: INCIDENT -> resolved (mitigation complete) at 3234567600.

raj (sre): logging final note to incident ticket with config diffs and graphs.

maria (oncall): closing thread, tagging postmortem request to eng-runtime. thanks team.
